false_is_zero.note: Presented as writing false as the single byte 0x00 'like every other zero'; RLP encodes false as the empty string 0x80, so every false field is encoded wrongly.

big_input_no_tail_check.note: Skips DecodeBytes' trailing-data check for inputs over 1 KiB ('large inputs are always single blocks'); a large encoding followed by extra bytes is now accepted instead of failing with ErrMoreThanOneValue. The tests only append trailing data to short inputs.

no_buffer_pool.note: Presented as removing sync.Pool overhead from EncodeToBytes; every call now allocates a fresh encBuffer and grows its slices from zero, which costs more than the pool.
